blocks.text: as ... as va not as ... as

87–88-darslarda farqni aytdik: older **than**, more expensive **than**. Ba'zan esa ikki narsa **teng** ekanini yoki biri ikkinchisiga **yetmasligini** aytish kerak. O'zbekchada buning uchun `-dek` / `-day` («otasidek baland») va `-chalik` + emas («Toshkentchalik katta emas») qo'shimchalari bor. Ingliz tilida ikkalasi ham **as ... as** bilan quriladi, o'rtada sifatning **oddiy** shakli turadi (qiyosiy emas!): **as tall as**, **not as big as**.

rows: as **tall** as his father — otasidek baland
not as **cold** as yesterday — kechagichalik sovuq emas
the same **age** as me — men bilan tengdosh

blocks.text: **not as ... as** bir narsa ikkinchisidan «kamroq» ekanini yumshoq aytadi. Inkor **be** yoki yordamchi fe'lda bo'ladi: Bukhara **isn't as** big **as** Tashkent. Bir fikrni uch xil aytish mumkin: The metro **isn't as expensive as** a taxi = The metro is **cheaper than** a taxi = A taxi is **more expensive than** the metro. **not as ... as** ko'pincha muloyimroq eshitiladi: «Your flat **isn't as big as** ours» — «Your flat is smaller» dan ko'ra yumshoqroq.

rows: My bike **isn't as new as** yours.
The lake **isn't as deep as** the sea.
The sea is **deeper than** the lake.

items.text: The second hotel **wasn't as nice as** the first.
I can't swim **as fast as** you.
There aren't **as many** shops here **as** in the centre.

blocks.text: Fe'l bilan ham ishlaydi: I don't drive **as fast as** my brother. Miqdor uchun: **as much** + sanalmaydigan ot (as much money, as much time), **as many** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (as many people, as many questions) — 83-dars.

Inkorsiz **as ... as** tenglikni bildiradi: Bekzod is **as tall as** his father — Bekzod otasidek baland. Ko'pincha **just** («xuddi») yoki **almost / nearly** («deyarli») bilan keladi: **just as** good **as**, **almost as** warm **as**. Tayyor iboralar: **as soon as possible** — iloji boricha tez, **as** fast **as I can** — qo'limdan kelganicha tez, **as** much **as possible** — imkon qadar ko'p.

items.text: Your son is **almost as tall as** you now.
Homemade bread is **just as cheap as** bread from the shop.

blocks.text: as me yoki as I am

Olmosh qoidasi **than** dagidek (88-dars): so'zlashuvda obyekt olmoshi — as tall as **me**, as old as **him**; yoki ega + yordamchi fe'l — as tall as **I am**, as well as **he can**, as much as **we did**. Yordamchi fe'l gapning zamoniga mos keladi.

items.text: Your sister isn't **as shy as you**.
I can't sing **as well as she can**.

blocks.text: **the same as** — «... bilan bir xil»: Your bag is **the same as** mine. O'rtada ot ham kelishi mumkin: **the same age as** (tengdosh), **the same size as**, **the same colour as**, **the same price as**. Faqat **as**: «the same like», «the same with» — xato. Teskarisi — **different from** («... dan farq qiladi»): My job is **different from** yours.

items.text: My birthday is on **the same day as** yours.
Life in London is very **different from** life in Tashkent.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «as taller as» → **as tall as** (o'rtada qiyosiy shakl emas, oddiy sifat); «not as big than» → **not as big as**; «He is tall as his father» → He is **as** tall **as** his father (birinchi as tushib qolmasin); «the same like me», «the same with me» → **the same as** me; «I am same age» → I'm **the same age as** you (the ham, as ham kerak).
Eslab qolish: «as — sifat — as» xuddi sendvich: ikki bo'lak non (**as**) orasida oddiy sifat. **than** faqat qiyosiy daraja bilan (bigger than), **as** — oddiy sifat bilan (as big as).
Bog'lanish: older, more expensive — 87-dars; than va much / a bit — 88-dars; eng ... (the oldest, the best) — 90-dars.

examples.title: **isn't as big as**: not as ... as
examples.description: **not as** + sifat + **as** — «...chalik emas». Sifat oddiy shaklda qoladi: Bukhara **isn't as big as** Tashkent — Buxoro **Toshkentchalik katta emas**.

sentences.text: Bukhara **isn't as big as** Tashkent.
It **isn't as hot** today **as** it was yesterday.
A train ticket **isn't as expensive as** a plane ticket.
My new phone **isn't as good as** my old one.
The film **wasn't as interesting as** the book.
Our flat **isn't as modern as** yours, but it's bigger.
Ben Nevis **isn't as high as** the mountains in Uzbekistan.
Football **isn't as popular** in America **as** it is in Europe.
The exam **wasn't as difficult as** we thought.
Life in the village **isn't as stressful as** in the city, but there aren't many jobs.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda hayot **shahardagichalik tashvishli emas**, lekin ish o'rinlari kam.

examples.title: Verbs: can't run **as fast as**, don't earn **as much as**
examples.description: Fe'l bilan ham: I can't run **as fast as** my brother (akamchalik tez yugura olmayman). Miqdor: **as much** + sanalmaydigan ot, **as many** + sanaladigan ot.

sentences.text: I can't run **as fast as** my brother.
Tom doesn't speak Russian **as well as** Emma.
We didn't play **as well as** last week.
This year it didn't rain **as much as** last year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil **o'tgan yilgidek ko'p** yomg'ir yog'madi.

sentences.text: Aziz doesn't earn **as much money as** his wife.
There aren't **as many tourists** in winter **as** in summer.
Grandad doesn't drive **as often as** he used to.
The new printer doesn't work **as quickly as** the old one.
Madina hasn't got **as much free time as** she had at university.
I didn't sleep **as long as** I wanted because the neighbours were noisy.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilar shovqin qilgani uchun **xohlaganimchalik ko'p** uxlay olmadim.

examples.title: **as** ... **as**: **just as good**, **almost as warm**
examples.description: Tenglik: **as** + sifat + **as** — «...dek, ...day»: as tall as his father — otasidek baland. **just as** — «xuddi ...dek», **almost as** — «deyarli ...dek».

sentences.text: Bekzod is now **as tall as** his father.
The copy looks **just as good as** the original.
The old fridge works **as well as** a new one.
In April the weather in Tashkent is **almost as warm as** in summer.
Our hotel room was **as comfortable as** a real home.
Dilnoza sings **as beautifully as** her mother does.
These cheap headphones are **just as loud as** the expensive ones.
sentences.translation: Bu arzon quloqchinlar ovozi **xuddi qimmatlaridek baland**.

sentences.text: The tea in this café is **as good as** my grandmother's.
James wants a car — **as safe as** a big one and **as cheap as** a small one.
sentences.translation: Jeyms mashina xohlaydi — **kattasidek xavfsiz** va **kichigidek arzon**.

sentences.text: Our first night in London was **as exciting as** we hoped.
sentences.translation: Londondagi birinchi kechamiz **biz kutgandek qiziqarli** o'tdi.

examples.title: **as soon as possible**, **as fast as I could**
examples.description: **as** ... **as possible** — «iloji boricha, imkon qadar»: **as soon as possible**. **as** ... **as I can / could** — «qo'limdan kelganicha».

sentences.text: Please call me back **as soon as possible**.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **iloji boricha tezroq** qayta qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: I ran **as fast as I could**, but I missed the bus.
sentences.translation: **Bor kuchim bilan** yugurdim, lekin avtobusga ulgurmadim.

sentences.text: Try to answer **as many questions as you can**.
sentences.translation: **Iloji boricha ko'p** savolga javob berishga harakat qiling.

sentences.text: Come home **as early as you can** — it's Grandma's birthday.
sentences.translation: **Iloji boricha erta** uyga kel — buvining tug'ilgan kuni.

sentences.text: The doctor told me to drink **as much water as possible**.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **imkon qadar ko'p** suv ichishimni aytdi.

sentences.text: Keep your answers **as short as possible**.
Madina saved **as much money as she could** for her trip to London.
sentences.translation: Madina London safari uchun **qo'lidan kelganicha ko'p** pul yig'di.

sentences.text: Drive **as carefully as possible** — the roads are icy.
sentences.translation: **Imkon qadar ehtiyot** bo'lib haydang — yo'llar muz.

sentences.text: Bekzod tries to visit his parents **as often as he can**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ota-onasini **iloji boricha tez-tez** ko'rgani borishga harakat qiladi.

sentences.text: I'll finish the report **as quickly as I can** and send it to you.
sentences.translation: Hisobotni **imkon qadar tez** tugatib, sizga yuboraman.

examples.title: **as me** / **as I am** / **as we do**
examples.description: Olmosh **than** dagidek (88-dars): **as** tall **as me** yoki **as** tall **as I am**; yordamchi fe'l zamonga mos: as well as **he can**, as much as **we did**.

sentences.text: My younger brother is nearly **as tall as me**.
I'm not **as patient as you are**.
Emma's husband cooks every evening — she can't cook **as well as he can**.
sentences.translation: Emmaning eri har kuni kechqurun ovqat pishiradi — Emma **undek yaxshi** pishira olmaydi.

sentences.text: You don't work **as hard as I do**!
Our children aren't **as tired as us** after the long journey.
Their team didn't train **as much as we did**, so we won.
sentences.translation: Ularning jamoasi **bizchalik ko'p** mashq qilmadi, shuning uchun biz yutdik.

sentences.text: Grandma still walks **as quickly as we do**.
Nobody in our class speaks English **as fluently as her**.
sentences.translation: Sinfimizda hech kim ingliz tilida **undek ravon** gapirmaydi.

sentences.text: My father didn't have **as many chances as I have** now.
I'm sure you'll do **as well as they did** in the competition.

examples.title: **the same as**, **the same age as**
examples.description: **the same as** — «... bilan bir xil». Ot bilan: **the same age as** (tengdosh), **the same colour as**. Teskarisi — **different from**. «the same like» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Your phone is **the same as** mine.
Madina is **the same age as** my sister.
The weather today is **the same as** yesterday — grey and wet.
Is this bus ticket **the same price as** last year?
I've got **the same** shoes **as** you, but in black.
sentences.translation: Menda ham **sizniki bilan bir xil** tufli bor, faqat qora rangda.

sentences.text: Tom was born on **the same day as** his grandfather.
Their house is **different from** ours — it's got two floors.
sentences.translation: Ularning uyi **biznikidan farq qiladi** — ikki qavatli.

sentences.text: We stayed at **the same hotel as** last time, near the Registan.
Dilnoza's dress is **the same colour as** the curtains!
Life in the village is not **the same as** it was twenty years ago.

examples.title: Questions: **Is it as good as** ...?
examples.description: Savol va qisqa javob: **Is** Oxford **as big as** London? — No, it's much smaller. Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon: **isn't as bright as** ..., but **is as big as** ...

sentences.text: Is Oxford **as big as** London? — No, it's much smaller.
Is the new teacher **as strict as** the old one? — No, she's much nicer.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchi **eskisidek qattiqqo'lmi**? — Yo'q, u ancha yoqimli.

sentences.text: Was the second book **as good as** the first? — Not really.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi kitob **birinchisidek yaxshi** edimi? — Unchalik emas.

sentences.text: Are oranges **as cheap as** apples here? — Yes, in winter they are.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda apelsin **olmadek arzonmi**? — Ha, qishda shunday.

sentences.text: Does Aziz speak English **as well as** his sister? — Almost.
sentences.translation: Aziz ingliz tilida **singlisidek yaxshi** gapiradimi? — Deyarli.

sentences.text: Can you get there **as quickly** by bus **as** by metro? — No, the bus is slower.
sentences.translation: U yerga avtobusda ham **metrodagidek tez** yetib borsa bo'ladimi? — Yo'q, avtobus sekinroq.

sentences.text: The flat **isn't as bright as** in the photos, but it **is as big as** they said.
Manchester **is as rainy as** people say — it rained every day!
sentences.translation: Manchester **odamlar aytgandek yomg'irli** ekan — har kuni yomg'ir yog'di!

sentences.text: My English **isn't as good as** I want, but it's getting better.
sentences.translation: Inglizcham **men xohlaganchalik yaxshi emas**, lekin yaxshilanyapti.

sentences.text: The museum in Bukhara **wasn't as crowded as** the one in Samarkand, so we stayed longer.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi muzey **Samarqanddagichalik gavjum emas** edi, shuning uchun u yerda uzoqroq qoldik.

examples.title: Dialogue: twin brothers
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: egizaklar haqida suhbat — **the same as**, **as** ... **as**, **not as** ... **as** va **different**.

sentences.text: — Is your twin brother **the same as** you?
— We look **the same**, but we're very **different** people.
sentences.translation: — Ko'rinishimiz **bir xil**, lekin biz juda **boshqa-boshqa** odamlarmiz.

sentences.text: — Really? Is he **as tall as** you?
— Yes, exactly — we're **the same height**, and we've got **the same** voice.
sentences.translation: — Ha, xuddi — **bo'yimiz bir xil**, ovozimiz ham **bir xil**.

sentences.text: — So what's different? Is he **as quiet as** you?
sentences.translation: — Unda farqi nimada? U ham **sendek kamgapmi**?

sentences.text: — Not at all! I'm **not as talkative as** him.
— And at school? Were you both **as good as** each other?
— No, I wasn't **as good** at maths **as** he was, but I was better at languages.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, men matematikadan **undek yaxshi emas** edim, lekin tillarni yaxshiroq bilardim.

sentences.text: — Who's older, then? — He is, but only by twenty minutes, so we're almost **the same age**!
sentences.translation: — Unda kim katta? — U, lekin bor-yo'g'i yigirma daqiqaga, shuning uchun deyarli **tengdoshmiz**!

sentences.text: — I'm jealous — my sister and I aren't **as close as** you two.
sentences.translation: — Havasim keldi — singlim ikkalamiz **sizlardek yaqin emasmiz**.
